The Refuge is prosperous because people learned how to survive Sablewood, not because Sablewood became safe. Make success in Sablewood feel costly and communal. Sturdy roofs, route trophies, repair yards, and warm windows sit behind practical defenses. Travelers watch the sky before entering the main lane. Some wealth is hazard pay made permanent. Leaf-drip, insects, distant wingbeats, and animal calls that stop or resume according to pressure, not comfort. Smoke, wet leather, hot stew, sawdust, and oil from maintained gear. Door handles are heavy and warm; defensive rails are smooth from frequent checks. The forest is populated even when no NPC is present; silence, birds, insects, and tracks are actionable signals.
